title: Technical Account Manager
summary: Technical account managers (TAMs) are the named technical contact for a set of large customers of a software or cloud product. They sit between the customer, support, product and engineering teams, and keep customers healthy by solving problems early and helping them use more of the product.
dailyDuties: Hold regular calls with customer engineering teams
Track open tickets and push urgent escalations to resolution
Debug customer integration problems with API logs and queries
Run quarterly business reviews on usage and adoption
Pass feature requests and bug patterns to product teams
Plan upgrades and new feature rollouts with customers

skills.expectation: Own the technical relationship with a set of enterprise customers and drive product adoption
Explain technical issues and plans clearly to customer engineers and managers
Coordinate support, product and engineering teams on customer needs
Reproduce customer issues and lead root cause analysis
Read API requests, responses and webhooks to debug integrations
Manage escalations during outages and share postmortems with customers
Break down vague customer problems into clear next steps
Query product data to check usage and investigate issues
Track customer issues in a ticketing tool
Keep account notes and renewal risks in a CRM
Demo new features and run small proofs of concept for customers
Help customers set up SSO with SAML or OAuth
Understand customer deployments on a public cloud

certifications.why: Basic cloud vocabulary for customer conversations
Basic cloud vocabulary for customers on Azure
